Sure! Here is the plan for this sketch. I have kept the brief short and picked
the assertions from the list you gave me.

**Brief**
A dense mesh of pale lines rotates slowly in three dimensions above a dark
ground, so its silhouette is never the same twice. Dragging the mouse turns the
mesh with the cursor, and letting go leaves it turning on its own again from
wherever it was left.

**Assertions**
- motion(idle)
- responds(drag)
- uses(webgl)

I chose uses(webgl) because the mesh is described as three-dimensional. Let me
know if you would like me to add a size, or to make the sketch still instead!
